title: Eight-Area Career Development Roadmap: DRC Edition
subtitle: 16 November 2026 – 31 January 2027 · follow the order, not the dates
bottomLine: One plan, eight areas, all moving every week, for about 8.5 hours of study a week plus exercise: 45 minutes on weekday evenings, about 2 hours on Saturday and about 2¾ hours on Sunday. Busy go-live week? Switch to the reduced routine (about 20 minutes a day). Follow the order, not the dates. A missed day moves the next task one slot later; nothing is lost.

areas.name: Python and AI
areas.objective: Go-live Data Kit: validator + coded RAG assistant
areas.byEnd: Demo #1 and Demo #2 sent; 16/20 then 20/25 test scores
areas.assessed: Write and explain a function without AI; the validator finds exactly the planted errors. RAG: explain chunking, retrieval and source attribution aloud; test score on fixed questions
areas.notEnough: Code that runs but you can't explain; one good-looking answer
areas.success: Demo #1 and Demo #2 sent; validator finds every planted error in both files; RAG 16/20, then 20/25
rules: Every session starts with revision (15 min Sat, 10 min Sun): rewrite last session's main code from memory, then compare.
Predict the output before you run anything. Type the code yourself. Stuck for 15 minutes? Ask for a hint, not the solution.
Fake data only. Save code to your private GitHub repo and to Drive after each session.

areas.name: Accounting
areas.byEnd: Journal and ledger, tested cold: 10/12 on test #2
areas.assessed: Cold transactions with no answers in view; cumulative tests
areas.stretch: 12/12, and you can explain each entry
rules: Watching a lecture is not mastery. Every lecture is followed by work you do before seeing the answer.
Every Monday starts with a cold 10-card quiz on the previous week. Mistakes become new flashcards.
Ravi Traders is your fictional business for all practice. Use made-up amounts.
Lecture numbers match the IIT Mandi course list. If your course run numbers differ, follow the same topic order.

areas.name: French
areas.assessed: Quiz both directions; sentences you build; a 1-minute recording
rules: Mon: words 1–5, one sentence each · Tue: words 6–10, listen 3 min · Wed: read the 5 model sentences, translate back · Thu: say them aloud 3 times, record 1 min · Fri: use 2 words at work; 10-word quiz both directions.
Holiday weeks 6 and 7 have 4 days: Wednesday combines reading, speaking and recording; Thursday is the quiz.

areas.name: Communication
areas.byEnd: Habits most days; recordings 7/10; 2 user trainings
areas.assessed: Rubric score; listener can repeat the point
areas.success: Habits on most days; recordings 7/10; 2 trainings delivered
rules: Mon: speak early · Tue: “So to confirm…” · Wed: same-day written summary · Thu: explain one process twice · Fri: one concise update (done · next · blocker).
Recordings, demos and trainings are scored with the 5-criterion rubric (0–2 each, out of 10). Targets: 6/10 in November–December, 7/10 in January. Listen once and write one thing to change next time.

areas.name: LinkedIn
areas.assessed: Conversations started and useful (2+ messages each)
rules: One person a week. Ask about their work, never for a job, and never send mass requests.
A conversation counts as started when you've sent a personal note with one real question; it counts as useful when you've exchanged at least two messages.
If LinkedIn won't let you add a note, connect without one and message after they accept.

Note template (about 240 characters): Hi [Name], I work on ERP implementations (right now a go-live in DR Congo) and I'm moving towards SAP finance. Your work on [X] caught my eye. Could I ask you one question about [their topic]? Thanks, Nani

areas.name: Evidence log
areas.byEnd: A line most working days; 3 STAR stories
areas.assessed: Lines with a real result; STAR stories written
areas.notEnough: Lines that say only “worked on X”
areas.success: Lines on 80% of working days; 3 STAR stories
areas.stretch: Manager uses one of your stories
rules: One line at the end of each working day, even on bad days. Say “the client”, never a name; use rough numbers; nothing confidential, and only what you're allowed to use.

Each Sunday, star the best line of the week (★). Three STAR stories, each from that month's starred lines: #1 Mon 30 Nov · #2 Thu 31 Dec · #3 Fri 29 Jan. Situation (1 line) · Task (1) · Action (2–3) · Result (1, with a number), under 150 words.

areas.name: Tracker app
areas.objective: A reliable app for all 8 areas
areas.byEnd: v1.0.1 on your phone with this plan imported; restore tested
areas.assessed: Features tested on the phone; data survives restart, update and restore
areas.success: v1.0.1 installed; this plan imported; restore drill passed
rules: 30 minutes a step, on Sundays. If a step isn't finished at 40 minutes, stop and continue next Sunday: the order matters, not the date. The app never takes time from accounting or Python.
Safety: private repo; no company or client data in the app; the signing key lives only in GitHub Secrets and your private Drive.

areas.name: Health, family and money
areas.byEnd: Sleep and exercise most days; 3 money checks; family steps
areas.budget: Exercise 3 × 25 · alone time 2 × 15 · Sat 60 off · call 25
areas.assessed: Counts: sleep nights, exercise sessions, calls, money checks
areas.success: Sleep 7 h on most nights; exercise 2–3 times most weeks; 3 money checks; dated family steps
areas.stretch: No week without a family call
rules: Every day: 7 hours of sleep with a fixed lights-out time; bottled or treated water; malaria prevention exactly as your doctor prescribed (net and repellent too). Measured as nights with 7 h (target 5 of 7).

Mon · Wed · Fri: 20–30 min exercise (target 3 sessions; 2 is fine). Tue · Thu: 10–20 min good alone time. Saturday: 60 minutes fully off. Sunday: call home; note the week's spending total in the review.
After a very long day: next evening, only the log line, then sleep. Nothing else is owed.

Never trade sleep, health or family for a streak. If you feel low most days for 2 weeks or more: tell someone you trust and see a doctor (in DRC, through your company's medical contact). In India, Tele-MANAS is free and open 24×7: 14416 or 1-800-891-4416. It's an Indian number, so it may not connect from a Congolese SIM.

areas.name: Weekly review
areas.assessed: Every area has an actual result written, not just ticks
rules: Be honest in the review. A ticked task with a weak result is written as weak. Two weeks in a row below target in one area means the plan changes (fewer new topics, more practice), not that you try harder on less sleep.

criteria.name: Clarity
levels: Main point in the first 15 seconds

criteria.name: Confidence
levels: Steady pace; 3 fillers a minute or fewer; no apologising

criteria.name: Accuracy
levels: Every fact checked against your notes

criteria.name: Audience
levels: A non-expert could repeat it; one concrete example

rubric.note: Listen once and write one thing to change next time.

reduced.action: One line every day: busy weeks produce the best evidence
2 words used at work; Friday 10-word quiz
“So to confirm…” once a day (it saves you time)
Saturday: 15-min revision + finish only the current step. Sunday off
Sleep first; two 10-min walks; Sunday call home
10 min Sunday: which week to repeat

recovery: Missed a day? Don't double up. Do the next task in order tomorrow.
Missed a week? Repeat the Monday quiz first, then continue where you stopped.
Two reduced weeks in a row? Shift every later date by one week. The sequence stays; only dates move.
Missing a week is fine. Don't let it become a month.
rules: Fictional data only for all practice.
Never put client names, PAN, GSTIN, bank details, invoices or confidential internal information into external AI tools or personal repositories, unless the company expressly approves it.
Type and understand code; don't copy AI output blindly. Predict the output before running it.
Stuck for 15 minutes? Ask for a hint, not a complete solution.
Keep the plan manageable during go-live periods: use the reduced routine without guilt.
Recover after missed days by continuing in order, not by doubling up.
Protect health, sleep and family responsibilities. No streak is worth losing them.
No new subjects unless this plan is reviewed first.
Keep the original objectives unless there's a clear, written reason to change one.
Private GitHub repos; app signing key only in GitHub Secrets and your private Drive.

accountingQuestions.prompt: Who is personally liable, without limit, for a sole trader's debts?
accountingQuestions.explanation: A sole trader and the business are the same person in law.

accountingQuestions.prompt: A company's shareholders are liable for its debts…
options: Only up to the capital they put in
accountingQuestions.answer: Only up to the capital they put in
accountingQuestions.explanation: That's limited liability: the company is a separate legal person.

accountingQuestions.prompt: Which is a separate legal entity?
accountingQuestions.explanation: A company can own assets and be sued in its own name.

accountingQuestions.prompt: Ravi Traders' machinery is…
accountingQuestions.explanation: It's owned and used for years.

accountingQuestions.prompt: A bank loan Ravi Traders must repay is…
accountingQuestions.explanation: It's owed to someone else.

accountingQuestions.prompt: Sales of goods are…
accountingQuestions.explanation: Money earned by the business.

accountingQuestions.prompt: Rent paid for the shop is…
accountingQuestions.explanation: A cost of running the business.

accountingQuestions.prompt: In an accounting information system, a vendor invoice keyed into the ERP is the…
accountingQuestions.explanation: Input → process (checks, posting) → output (entries, reports).

accountingQuestions.prompt: A current asset is…
options: Stock you expect to sell this year
accountingQuestions.answer: Stock you expect to sell this year
accountingQuestions.explanation: Current means within about a year.

accountingQuestions.prompt: Where does a vendor's unpaid invoice appear?
accountingQuestions.explanation: You owe it soon, so it's a current liability.

accountingQuestions.prompt: Gross profit is…
options: Sales minus cost of goods sold
accountingQuestions.answer: Sales minus cost of goods sold
accountingQuestions.explanation: Net profit then subtracts the running expenses.

accountingQuestions.prompt: An expense is booked when…
accountingQuestions.explanation: That's the accrual principle.

accountingQuestions.prompt: Prudence (conservatism) means…
options: Use a new method every year
accountingQuestions.explanation: Expect losses; don't count gains before they happen.

accountingQuestions.prompt: Cash is which type of account?
accountingQuestions.explanation: Things you own (cash, furniture, goods) are real accounts.

accountingQuestions.prompt: A vendor is which type of account?
accountingQuestions.explanation: People and businesses are personal accounts.

accountingQuestions.prompt: Salaries are which type of account?
accountingQuestions.explanation: Expenses, losses, incomes and gains are nominal accounts.

accountingQuestions.prompt: Ravi Traders buys goods for ₹10,000 + 18% GST on credit. The entry is…
options: Dr Purchases 10,000 · Dr Input GST 1,800 · Cr Vendor 11,800
Dr Vendor 11,800 · Cr Purchases 10,000 · Cr Input GST 1,800
Dr Purchases 10,000 · Cr Vendor 10,000 · Cr Output GST 1,800
accountingQuestions.answer: Dr Purchases 10,000 · Dr Input GST 1,800 · Cr Vendor 11,800
accountingQuestions.explanation: GST paid on purchases is Input GST (a debit); the vendor is owed the total.

accountingQuestions.prompt: Ravi Traders sells goods for ₹20,000 + 18% GST on credit. The entry is…
options: Dr Customer 23,600 · Cr Sales 20,000 · Cr Output GST 3,600
Dr Sales 20,000 · Dr Output GST 3,600 · Cr Customer 23,600
accountingQuestions.answer: Dr Customer 23,600 · Cr Sales 20,000 · Cr Output GST 3,600
accountingQuestions.explanation: GST charged on sales is Output GST, a credit owed to the government.

accountingQuestions.prompt: Ravi Traders pays a vendor ₹9,800 in full settlement of ₹10,000. The entry is…
options: Dr Vendor 10,000 · Cr Bank 9,800 · Cr Discount received 200
Dr Vendor 10,000 · Dr Discount allowed 200 · Cr Bank 10,200
Dr Bank 9,800 · Dr Discount received 200 · Cr Vendor 10,000
accountingQuestions.answer: Dr Vendor 10,000 · Cr Bank 9,800 · Cr Discount received 200
accountingQuestions.explanation: The full debt is cleared; the ₹200 not paid is income.

accountingQuestions.prompt: After the journal, the next step is…
accountingQuestions.explanation: Journal → ledger → (in February) trial balance.

accountingQuestions.prompt: Why does Capital normally have a credit balance?
options: The business owes it to the owner
accountingQuestions.answer: The business owes it to the owner
accountingQuestions.explanation: Liabilities and capital sit on the credit side.

pythonQuestions.prompt: In your RAG assistant, a chunk is…
options: A small piece of a note, stored with its source
pythonQuestions.answer: A small piece of a note, stored with its source
pythonQuestions.explanation: RAG 1: split every note into chunks {text, source}.

pythonQuestions.prompt: Why store the source file with every chunk?
options: So every answer can name where it came from
pythonQuestions.answer: So every answer can name where it came from
pythonQuestions.explanation: Source attribution: the answer names the right file.

pythonQuestions.prompt: Keyword retrieval scores a chunk by…
options: How many of the question's words it contains
pythonQuestions.answer: How many of the question's words it contains
pythonQuestions.explanation: RAG 2: score, sort, keep the top 3.

pythonQuestions.prompt: TF-IDF gives a word more weight when it is…
options: Frequent in this chunk but rare across all chunks
pythonQuestions.answer: Frequent in this chunk but rare across all chunks
pythonQuestions.explanation: Rare, specific words tell chunks apart.

pythonQuestions.prompt: Without an approved API key, the offline 'answer' is…
options: The top 3 chunks with their sources
pythonQuestions.answer: The top 3 chunks with their sources
pythonQuestions.explanation: Offline route: keyword or TF-IDF retrieval only.

pythonQuestions.prompt: Where should an approved API key live?
options: In a .env file, never in the code
In the code, near the top
pythonQuestions.answer: In a .env file, never in the code
pythonQuestions.explanation: Keys in code leak through GitHub.

pythonQuestions.prompt: Why test with 20 fixed questions that have expected answers?
options: To measure accuracy and see whether a change helps
pythonQuestions.answer: To measure accuracy and see whether a change helps
pythonQuestions.explanation: A fixed test turns 'seems good' into a score.

pythonQuestions.prompt: Your score is 14/20. What do you fix first?
options: The notes behind the wrong answers, then re-test
pythonQuestions.answer: The notes behind the wrong answers, then re-test
pythonQuestions.explanation: Fix the weakest notes and re-test (Sun 20 Dec).
